item.title: An uncommon network of tunnels
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Suspense and adventure (not sure what it may be)

Page Layout:
Containment procedures and description; followed by in-depth information, such as exploration logs, interviews, related documents or tests, which present events in a non-linear sequence. The page may use darker (in color) elements for ambiance sake (in regards to in-universe design and narrative support).
In-depth information may be organized in different parts with a ListPages module or any other medium for focusing.

Elevator Pitch:

► A mostly subterranean network of tunnels that has the following properties
▼ A mostly subterranean network of tunnels that has the following properties:
  • Inner distances (mainly the longitudinal extension) and shapes of some tunnels don't match those expected by outside measurements, especially in underground ones.
  • Various tunnels lead to impossible locations, such as the end of other tunnel, structures not existing outside the network or different realities.
  • It connects (not necessarily directly) to odd places of different nature and varying degrees of relation with each other.
  • It appears to be infinite in size and has entrances all around the world.
  • Network and attached rooms are occupied by diverse kinds of entities, items and information. They are not always hostile or sentient but inherently imply a risk.
  • Anomalous events occur within the complex; for example, reality-based, space-time and biological distortions.
  • Antimemetic and physical qualities affect the network so that all attempts to bring logic to the spatial paradox meet failure.

Central Narrative:
After the containment procedures and the description are told, the article will focus on the experiences around this SCP and the hidden history of the places "inside" it.

► This second part of the article will relate this information in the form of records
▼ This second part of the article will relate this information in the form of records,

for instance, the incidents lived and findings made by separate Foundation teams on exploration procedures, the speech of sapient beings inhabiting the tunnels, the unraveling of the stories of the facilities connected to the network; going from initial approaches upon discovery, up to how a guide-rope tied to an agent (who ventured into the tunnels) conducts to the corpse of the latter, despite she exited through the other end of a tunnel alive and tied to the guide-rope.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

► The "heart" of this concept is the in-depth data
▼ The "heart" of this concept is the in-depth data,

because of its significance for the article and how it is presented as a set of mysteries revolving around these places, which are features that, to my knowledge, are not prominent in the wiki.
All of this written as Foundation registries and excerpts from independent documents, having both clinical and literary tone. That is, the capacity of an informative text to not only tell data, but also narrate a story.

Additional Notes:
My major concerns are on the literary emphasis of the SCP, since I wouldn't like to create a tale made into an article. Keep in mind the concept is intended to form an actual SCP article, not a tale page designed as one.
